## Summary

Main-push commit validation accepts long GitHub noreply co-author trailers on squash commits. The 100-character limit still applies to other footer lines.

## Evidence

- **Before** · [Post-merge Quality](https://github.com/lhajoosten/rolling-release/actions/runs/44997919401) rejected the trailer GitHub added to the v0.8.1 squash landing.
- **After** · The exact failed commit range passes. The regression test accepts a long GitHub co-author trailer and rejects a long breaking-change footer. All 28 commit-message tests passed.
- The complete verification suite passed in the commit hook, including the packaged CLI fixture, architecture checks and docs build.

## Merge Danger

**Door** · Reversible in a follow-up PR.

**Blast radius** · Main-push commit-message checks.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Accept GitHub co-author trailers in main-push commit checks.
impact: GitHub-generated trailers on squash commits no longer fail Quality solely for their length.
required_action: null
```

pullRequests.body:
## Summary

Require a successful Quality run on the exact reviewed release landing before the first image, tag, or GitHub Release write. Pending results defer publication. Failed results block the candidate and allow an ordinary fix to produce a replacement proposal.

Run push Quality independently for each main commit so a later push can leave a release landing with usable evidence. Journaled recovery still verifies the retained outputs.

## Evidence

- **Before** · v0.8.1 [published](https://github.com/lhajoosten/rolling-release/actions/runs/44997919392) even though [Quality failed](https://github.com/lhajoosten/rolling-release/actions/runs/44997919401) on its landing.
- **After** · Publication fixtures confirm that missing, pending, failed, and wrong-SHA Quality evidence permits zero writes. Successful exact-SHA evidence unlocks publication. An interrupted release resumes from its verified image and journal.
- The full repository commit hook passed, including behavioral tests, architecture checks and the docs build. Actionlint also passed.

## Merge Danger

**Door** · Reversible through a reviewed workflow change.

**Blast radius** · Rolling Release provider publication. Consumer callers use their existing independent workflows.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Gate provider publication on Quality for the reviewed main landing.
impact: The release image, tag, and GitHub Release wait for successful Quality on the exact source being published.
required_action: null
```
